title: Microsoft Teams: automatic recording and transcription options follow meeting policies
summary: Pass. The rollout dates, policy combinations, existing controls and licensing qualifications are supported by the supplied Microsoft notice, roadmap and Microsoft Learn. Searches found no documentation resolving the page's narrowly stated questions about the new menu.

claims.claim: Set-CsTeamsMeetingPolicy -Identity <policy name> -AutoRecording Enabled or Disabled controls whether organisers have the automatic setting.

Set-CsTeamsMeetingPolicy -Identity <policy name> -AutoRecording Disabled

claims.claim: The recording toggle is at Teams admin center > Meetings > Meeting policies > policy > Meeting recording.
claims.quote: In the left navigation of the Teams admin center, go to Meetings > Meeting policies. ... Select an existing policy or create a new one. ... Turn the Meeting recording toggle On or Off.

claims.claim: Set-CsTeamsMeetingPolicy -Identity <policy name> -AllowCloudRecording $true or $false controls meeting recording permission.
claims.quote: To manage meeting recording by using PowerShell, use the -AllowCloudRecording parameter in Set-CsTeamsMeetingPolicy. ... Set-CsTeamsMeetingPolicy -Identity "Your Policy Name" -AllowCloudRecording $true

claims.where: controls[2].ui; Governance controls table row 3; Governance guidance

claims.claim: Set-CsTeamsMeetingPolicy -Identity <policy name> -AllowTranscription $true or $false controls meeting transcription permission.
